use_when: 应用需要读写自身沙箱内的配置、缓存或日志文件，并通过FilePicker让用户选择或保存文档、图片等用户文件 / When an app needs to read and write its own sandboxed config, cache, or log files, and use FilePicker to let users select or save documents, images, and other user files
在应用沙箱目录中创建、读写、移动或删除配置、缓存、日志等应用文件 / Create, read, write, move, or delete app files such as configuration, cache, and logs in the app sandbox directory

如何使用ArkTS或C/C++进行应用文件的创建、读写、删除操作

当你的应用需要读写自身沙箱内的应用文件（如配置文件、缓存数据、日志等），或需要通过FilePicker让用户选择、保存文件到用户目录时，可以使用Core File Kit提供的应用文件访问和FilePicker接口
当你的应用需要实现数据备份恢复、需要适配HarmonyOS到HarmonyOS NEXT的数据迁移、或需要实现跨设备文件访问和端云文件同步等高级功能时，可以使用Core File Kit提供的相应能力
创建并读写应用沙箱里的本地文件 / Create and read-write local files in the app sandbox
把日志、缓存或导出内容保存成文件到应用目录 / Save logs, cache, or exported content as files in the app directory
读取文档、图片或音频文件内容并在应用内处理 / Load document, image, or audio file content for in-app processing
删除临时文件并清理应用存储空间 / Delete temporary files and clean up app storage
遍历文件夹并管理目录下的文件列表 / Traverse folders and manage files in a directory
用 FilePicker 让用户选择要导入的图片或文档 / Let users pick images or documents to import with FilePicker
用 FilePicker 把生成的文件另存到用户可见目录 / Save generated files to a user-visible location with FilePicker
通过 URI 向其他应用分享附件或导出文件 / Share attachments or exported files with other apps via URI
实现应用数据备份并在重装后恢复文件 / Back up app data and restore files after reinstall
迁移旧版本应用的本地文件数据到 HarmonyOS NEXT / Migrate local app file data from an older version to HarmonyOS NEXT
接入跨设备文件传输并同步共享文件内容 / Integrate cross-device file transfer and sync shared file content
配置应用沙箱共享目录并读写共享文件 / Configure a shared app sandbox directory and read-write shared files
do_not_use_when: 需求是解析txt、epub、mobi、azw、azw3电子书，进行排版分页并提供阅读交互；应改用 reader-kit / The task is to parse txt, epub, mobi, azw, or azw3 ebooks, perform layout and pagination, and provide reading interactions; use reader-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成可用的 HarmonyOS Core File Kit 能力并使用匹配的 API 版本 / The project has the HarmonyOS Core File Kit capability available and uses a compatible API version
若访问用户文件或使用 FilePicker，相关权限与模块配置已在 module.json5 中正确声明 / If accessing user files or using FilePicker, the required permissions and module configuration have been correctly declared in module.json5
若访问受用户授权保护的文件或目录，用户已完成授权，且持久化授权已按需保存 / If accessing user-protected files or directories, the user has granted permission and persistent authorization has been stored when needed

若使用分布式文件、备份恢复或端云协同，目标设备/服务可达且对应系统能力已启用 / If using distributed files, backup/restore, or device-cloud collaboration, the target devices/services are reachable and the required system capability is enabled
inputs: 应用沙箱文件路径或文件描述符 / App sandbox file path or file descriptor
用户文件 URI、媒体 URI 或 FilePicker 返回结果 / User file URI, media URI, or FilePicker result
文件操作参数（读写模式、复制/移动目标、过滤类型等） / File operation parameters such as read/write mode, copy/move destination, and picker filters
备份恢复、迁移、分布式访问或端云协同的配置参数 / Configuration parameters for backup/restore, migration, distributed access, or device-cloud collaboration
outputs: 应用沙箱目录路径（filesDir、cacheDir、tempDir、preferencesDir、databaseDir等） / Application sandbox directory paths such as filesDir, cacheDir, tempDir, preferencesDir, and databaseDir
文件对象与文件描述符（fs.File、fd） / File objects and file descriptors such as fs.File and fd
文件读写流对象（fs.Stream） / File read/write stream objects such as fs.Stream
读取到的文件内容数据（ArrayBuffer、字符串、字节数据） / File content data read from files, such as ArrayBuffer, strings, or bytes
文件或目录元数据对象（fs.Stat：大小、时间、类型、权限等） / File or directory metadata objects such as fs.Stat with size, time, type, and permission information
目录项或文件名列表 / Directory entries or file name lists
应用文件分享URI / Shareable application file URIs
用户选择的文件URI列表（文档、图片、视频、音频等） / URI lists of user-selected files such as documents, images, videos, and audio
图片选择结果对象（PhotoSelectResult，包含photoUris等） / Photo picker result objects such as PhotoSelectResult containing photoUris
FilePicker保存后生成的目标文件URI / Destination file URIs generated after saving through FilePicker
URI与本地路径转换结果（URI字符串、路径字符串） / URI and local path conversion results, including URI strings and path strings
持久化授权后的可持续访问文件或目录URI / Persistently authorized file or directory URIs for continued access
公共用户目录路径（Download、Desktop、Documents等） / Public user directory paths such as Download, Desktop, and Documents
应用空间与文件系统空间统计结果 / Application storage and file system space statistics
备份生成的应用数据文件或备份数据集 / Application data files or backup datasets produced during backup
恢复后的应用沙箱数据文件 / Restored application sandbox data files
迁移后的应用数据文件 / Migrated application data files
跨设备拷贝生成的目标文件 / Target files produced by cross-device copy
分布式文件系统中的共享文件路径或可访问文件 / Shared file paths or accessible files in the distributed file system
端云同步后的本地缓存文件、云端文件副本或版本化文件 / Local cached files, cloud file copies, or versioned files produced by device-cloud file synchronization

postconditions.statement: 代码已新增或修改为使用 Core File Kit 相关 API 完成文件访问、FilePicker、备份恢复、分布式文件或端云协同逻辑 / The code has been added or updated to use Core File Kit APIs for file access, FilePicker, backup/restore, distributed files, or device-cloud collaboration
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly introduce or modify HarmonyOS file-related code using Core File Kit style APIs or configuration for file access, FilePicker, backup/restore, distributed files, or device-cloud collaboration?

postconditions.statement: 若场景需要权限或能力声明，工程配置已同步补充必要的 module.json5 或相关声明 / If the scenario requires permissions or capability declarations, the project configuration has been updated with the necessary module.json5 or related declarations
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested file scenario needs permissions or capability declarations, do the edits include the necessary project configuration changes such as module.json5 updates?

postconditions.statement: 文件来源与目标路径/URI 在实现中被明确处理，避免将用户文件与应用沙箱文件混用 / File source and destination paths/URIs are handled explicitly in the implementation, avoiding confusion between user files and app sandbox files
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show clear handling of file paths or URIs and keep user-file flows distinct from app sandbox file flows?
